summary: Backend E2E tests for billing/payment toggle propagation. All 7 test scenarios covering the 3 recently-fixed bugs pass 100%: (1) PUT /api/monetization/settings returns 200 (was 405); (2) sub-flags default to True when master ON and no monetization doc exists; (3) Redis billing cache is invalidated on save (no stale reads). Additionally verified upsert pattern (1 doc only), legacy POST compatibility, cache-control headers, and admin/settings regression.
critical_code_review_comments: monetization.py is 1800+ lines — should be split (subscriptions, bundles, revenue, billing-status all in one file).
get_monetization_settings still sorts by created_at desc — since we now upsert to setting_id='monetization', reading by {'setting_id':'monetization'} would be cheaper and more deterministic.
save_monetization_settings sets created_at on every update (upsert) which resets the field — should use $setOnInsert for created_at.
billing-status default logic uses inline conditional expressions that are hard to read; consider a helper.
seed_data_creation: None — test fixtures clean monetization_settings between scenarios via direct MongoDB access (mongodb://localhost:27017/gracefy_db).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_billing_toggle_e2e.py is idempotent and re-runnable. It leaves admin_settings.billing_enabled=false at the end (scenario 7). Uses direct pymongo access to gracefy_db. All 3 originally-reported bugs are confirmed fixed.
rca of the issue: Original bugs: (a) MonetizationSettingsPage.jsx used PUT /monetization/settings but only POST /monetization-settings existed → 405; fix added dual-decorator @router.post('/monetization-settings') @router.put('/monetization/settings'). (b) /billing-status defaulted sub-flags to False when monetization_settings was empty → master toggle appeared ineffective; fix: when has_monetization_doc is False, sub-flag defaults are True. (c) save_monetization_settings never called invalidate_billing_cache → 10s stale window; fix added invalidate_billing_cache() call. All three verified via automated tests.
